root_cause_label: Lack of domain knowledge about POV-Ray 2.2 archive naming (.TAR.Z) leading to repeated failed downloads and eventual substitution with incompatible v3.8
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent lacked domain knowledge that POV-Ray 2.2 is distributed as POVSRC.TAR.Z (not povray22.tgz), exhausted all guessed URLs with 404 errors, then violated the task requirement by switching to build the modern v3.8 master branch which also failed to complete due to apt/dpkg lock issues.
t_err_evidence: Step 5: agent attempts wget with URL paths ending in 'povray22.tgz' — the wrong filename/format. The actual POV-Ray 2.2 archives are POVSRC.TAR.Z, POVDOC.TAR.Z, POVSCN.TAR.Z at ftp.povray.org/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/. Both URLs return 404.
t_commit_evidence: Step 22: agent downloads the GitHub master branch (POV-Ray v3.8) — 56MB tarball saved — and subsequently spends all remaining steps trying to build this wrong version. The agent explicitly states in step 26: 'Since POV-Ray 2.2 source appears to be unavailable from all archives, let me check if this version can be built.' After this download the trajectory is locked onto the wrong version.
t_surface_evidence: Step 27: running prebuild.sh on the v3.8 source fails with 'Failed to detect autoconf / prebuild.sh: error: requires autoconf 2.68 or above' — the first observable build failure signal after committing to the wrong version path.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked specific domain knowledge about how POV-Ray 2.2 was distributed in the early 1990s: the archives use the .TAR.Z compression format (compress utility) and are named POVSRC.TAR.Z, POVDOC.TAR.Z, POVSCN.TAR.Z, hosted at the official POV-Ray FTP under Old-Versions/Official-2.2/. The agent guessed 'povray22.tgz' (a .tgz file with a generic name) and never attempted the correct filenames or formats despite 15+ failed download attempts across many mirrors.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 5-21 show 15+ consecutive 404/503 errors across diverse mirrors (povray.org, archive.org, debian, fossies, ftp.sunet.se, web.archive.org, ibiblio, sourceforge, freebsd, gentoo, openbsd, lip6.fr, aarnet, funet, stanford, cs.utah, ntua.gr, github) all using the same wrong filename pattern 'povray22.tgz' or 'povray22.tar.gz'. Repeated commands and consistent failures were clear forewarning signals before the version switch at step 22.
